items.source: Register a subscription represented by the given message.
items.translation: 注册由给定消息表示的订阅。

items.source: Remove all subscriptions associated with the given sessionId.
items.translation: 删除与给定的 sessionId 关联的所有订阅。

items.source: A registry of subscription by session that allows looking up subscriptions.
items.translation: 按会话订阅的注册表，允许查找订阅。

items.source: Find all subscriptions that should receive the given message.
items.translation: 查找所有应接收给定消息的订阅。

items.source:
Find all subscriptions that should receive the given message.
The map returned is safe to iterate and will never be modified.
items.translation:
查找所有应接收给定消息的订阅。
返回的映射是安全的，可以迭代且永远不会被修改。
包含 sessionId-subscriptionId 对的MultiValueMap(可能为空)
